decisions.reason: The charting bundle is tied into the firm's core map.apps line and saw repeated releases, so its sunk development effort and fit with the platform favour keeping it despite less visibility on the website since 2019.

VueTOC was a small experimental component that has not been visible since its 2018 launch announcement, so little public commitment remains to justify it, and its function can be folded into other mobile offerings.

Mobile field data capture is central to the firm's integrated enterprise geospatial direction and had a dedicated page, so management will attribute its quieter presence to temporary adoption delays and keep investing in it.
